meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你要求报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关 bug 时,Claude 会先调查、复现并确认根因,然后生成一份英文 GitHub issue 或 PR,内容包括复现步骤、根因和修复建议,并自动分派到对应的仓库。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交或开启 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 把这个问题整理成 PR 提交到 openai/codex。
say.note: PR 仅允许提交到 openai/codex。

howto.what_en: When you report a LazyCodex or Codex bug, Claude investigates, reproduces it, and confirms the root cause, then creates an English GitHub issue or PR with reproduction steps, root cause, and fix suggestions, routed to the correct repository.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, or open a bug for LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI.

say_en.text: File a bug issue for the lazycodex repo: type A then it crashes; build info is below.
say_en.note: Claude reproduces first, then writes the issue.

say_en.text: This Codex CLI error looks upstream; investigate before deciding issue or PR.
say_en.note: It checks both source trees to route correctly.

say_en.text: Turn this into a PR for openai/codex.
say_en.note: PRs are only allowed against openai/codex.
